description:
The Avare aviation GPS app is open on the main map screen. Your task:
1. Tap the 'Find' tab at the bottom of the screen.
2. Look for or tap on the 'Nearest' button or option to see the nearest airports list.
3. The nearest airports list should display airports sorted by distance from the current GPS position.
4. Tap on any airport in the list to view its details (identifier, name, elevation, runways, frequencies).
5. Verify that airport detail information is displayed including the airport name and identifier.
